stem.text: An electron moves between two points X and Y in a uniform electric field, as shown.

stem.alt: Parallel horizontal field lines with arrowheads pointing right, labelled uniform electric field, with points X and Y marked between the lines.

stem.text: The distance between X and Y is $4.0\,\text{cm}$ and the line XY is at an angle of $60^{\circ}$ to the direction of the field.
The field exerts the only force on the electron.
What is the change in the kinetic energy of the electron as it moves from X to Y?
